name: keepalive
description: A prompt cache bar for every conversation, subagent and teammate, a dashboard with /keepalive, per-conversation cache TTLs, and upkeep that keeps an idle cache warm or compacts it before it expires. Requires Claude Code Mod function hooks enabled.

cache_ttl.title: Prompt cache TTL
cache_ttl.description: Prompt cache lifetime the main conversation starts in. Default keeps Claude Code's own choice; the cache bar's TTL button changes it for the session.

subagent_cache_ttl.title: Subagent prompt cache TTL
subagent_cache_ttl.description: Prompt cache lifetime each subagent starts in. Default keeps Claude Code's own choice; each subagent's TTL button changes it for that subagent.

teammate_cache_ttl.title: Teammate prompt cache TTL
teammate_cache_ttl.description: Prompt cache lifetime each teammate starts in. Default keeps Claude Code's own choice; each teammate's TTL button changes it for that teammate.

teammate_cache_upkeep.title: Teammate cache upkeep
teammate_cache_upkeep.description: Prompt cache upkeep that split-pane teammates start in. Each teammate's own mode button can change it. In-process teammates and subagents cannot be kept warm.

keepalive_limit.title: Keepalive limit
keepalive_limit.description: Keepalives warm and warmcomp send after each request before warming stops; warmcomp then compacts. default sends them while each costs less than rewriting the cache, infinite never stops, and a number sends exactly that many.
